lead.title: Distalmotion secures up to $70M senior term loan from Perceptive Advisors to roll out its DEXTER robot in US ambulatory surgery centers
lead.deck: The Swiss surgical robotics medtech is funding its US ASC expansion, development of the DEXTER system and a broader instrument portfolio. DEXTER is cleared for the four highest-volume outpatient soft-tissue procedures in the US (cholecystectomy, inguinal and ventral hernia repair, hysterectomy). A strong signal: small-footprint robotics is targeting the outpatient OR, where growth is happening.

milestone.title: FDA grants Breakthrough Device designation to Teleflex's Freesolve RMS resorbable magnesium coronary scaffold
milestone.summary: Freesolve RMS (BIOmag alloy, BIOlute bioabsorbable coating) shows 3.5% target lesion failure at four years in the BIOMAG-I first-in-human study, with no new clinical events between years two and four. The BIOMAG-III pivotal trial is ongoing to support a PMA application.
milestone.why: About 99% of the magnesium is resorbed within 12 months: the promise is a vessel with no permanent implant. Already CE-marked, the scaffold now gets priority access to the FDA, a sign that resorbable stents are seriously back in the race.

brefsEurope.title: UK to recognise CE marking of medical devices and IVDs indefinitely
brefsEurope.summary: Following a consultation (Feb 16–Apr 10, 2026), London drops the June 30, 2028 (old directives) and June 30, 2030 (MDR/IVDR) cut-offs. Over 90% of devices registered in the UK already carry the CE mark: a UK market open to European startups without dual certification.

brefsIntl.title: FDA approves expanded label for Edwards' Pascal Precision system in tricuspid edge-to-edge repair
brefsIntl.summary: The approval covers symptomatic severe tricuspid regurgitation on optimal medical therapy in patients at intermediate or higher surgical risk. It sets Edwards against Abbott's TriClip in tricuspid repair.

brefsIntl.title: Lunit SCOPE presents five studies at ESMO 2026, including AI PD-L1 scoring across 993 lung cancers
brefsIntl.summary: In 993 surgically resected NSCLC patients in Japan, pathologist-AI agreement reaches 73%, lowest in tumors scored PD-L1 negative. A second study (181 PDAC) links tumor-stroma ratio to survival depending on KRAS status.

brefsIntl.title: IceCure enrols first two patients in US ChoICE study of ProSense cryoablation
brefsIntl.summary: The prospective post-marketing study targets about 400 patients at up to 30 US centers; first enrolments took place at West Cancer Center (Tennessee) and Adventist Health Glendale (California).

word.full: Breakthrough Device Designation (FDA status for breakthrough devices)
word.definition: A US FDA label that gives privileged, faster access to FDA teams for devices aimed at serious or debilitating conditions, without lowering the level of evidence required.

parts.label: Criteria
parts.role: treats a serious or debilitating condition and brings a significant advantage

parts.label: Interactions
parts.role: frequent exchanges with the FDA, including "sprint discussions"

parts.label: Priority review
parts.role: faster review of future filings (IDE, 510(k), De Novo, PMA)

how.t: The manufacturer files a designation request with the FDA, showing the potential advantage over existing alternatives.
Once designated, it plans the clinical data plan and trial protocol with the FDA, with sprints on a single topic.
Later submissions are reviewed in priority, but against the same safety and effectiveness standards.

word.why: For a VC it is an upstream weak signal ahead of a raise: a BDD de-risks regulation and shortens development, and often precedes a round or an industrial partnership. It is not, however, a marketing authorization.
